blocking_finding.numeric_relation_period: Q1 FY2027 versus Q1 FY2026, period ends 2026-05-01 and 2025-05-02
blocking_finding.why_invalid_zh: 两项材料各自有来源，但没有任何已编译 TemporalRelation 授权模型把它们写成同期事实。
blocking_finding.impact_zh: 该句会让读者误以为产品 mix 解释与本次同比毛利率观察来自同一财季，因此不能通过金融事实 L1。

non_blocking_positive_observations: 最终状态诚实保持 insufficient_evidence / not_inferable / bridge_unavailable。
模型没有把 AI 服务器收入直接升级为分部或公司利润，也没有把产品写成亏损事实。
同财季毛利率同比关系本身由 S2 确定性 NumericRelation 支持。

content_quality.formal_score_reason: L1 未通过时不出具内容质量通过分；而且本次仅是一个动态研究单元，Q5 跨单元综合与 Q8 完整研报交付均不适用。
content_quality.diagnostic_observation: thesis 和 mechanism 保守且问题相关，counter/WWC 也提出了产品价格、出货量和利润桥路线，但时间关系越界是硬失败，不能用其余内容分数抵消。

root_cause.owning_layer: S3 dynamic ClaimRelation / fragment context / terminal validation
root_cause.earliest_faulty_artifact: dynamic fragment projection exposes individually dated Evidence and a same-basis NumericRelation but does not compile an explicit cross-item TemporalRelation or forbid the model from inventing one in narrative text
root_cause.required_structural_fix: compile temporal authority separately from evidence and numeric authority; a model may describe same-period or concurrent movement only by selecting an explicit compiled TemporalRelation. Evidence from another reporting period must be labeled historical_context and cannot be narrated as contemporaneous.
root_cause.anti_patch_boundary: Do not merely add one more prompt sentence or silently delete the word 同期. Preserve this attempt and add provider-neutral replay and mutation coverage for Chinese and English temporal linkage.

disposition.future_call_scope: one non-thinking same-fragment temporal repair submission using the already completed counter analysis and the same evidence authority

next_decision_boundary: Implement and prove provider-neutral temporal authority at the S3 fragment boundary, replay the immutable R3 output as a true-positive rejection, and allow at most one same-fragment model repair. Only an L1-valid repaired dynamic single-cell result can close this gate; high-quality five-cell work remains additionally blocked by RC-S1-019 source/index synchronization.
